Traders now see a better chance that the US Federal Reserve will hold off on more interest rate hikes. top.impact_reason: Shifts global rate expectations affecting local financing costs.
top.headline: Gold increases as falling oil prices fuel Federal Reserve pause hopes
top.summary: Gold prices ticked up following a drop in oil prices, easing inflation concerns. Investors are now anticipating that the US central bank will pause further interest rate increases.
top.why: Interest rate expectations directly influence mortgage costs and borrowing sentiment in Dubai.

A neighbour recently contacted me because different people appear to be entering the apartment every few days with suitcases. top.headline: Tenant illegally listing Dubai property as a holiday home without consent
top.summary: A Dubai Marina landlord discovered their long-term tenant was secretly operating their rented apartment as a short-term holiday home. The issue highlights risks regarding unauthorized subleasing and property control.

top.headline: RTA wins Dubai-it Award for fast infrastructure project delivery
